title: Create private model registry, provenance, version pinning and independent release approval
baseCommit: 70272ac8 (KAN-177 VMM-09 head; composes VMM-02 signing + VMM-09 approval verdicts)
whatBuilt: REGISTRATION: VMM-02 manifest validation + signature verification FIRST (mutated-field re-submissions with an old signature refused before the immutability shortcut), lineage checked across the registered set, manifests IMMUTABLE per id+version (different digest refused; identical digest re-registration idempotent)

ARTIFACT VAULT: real artifact bytes attach under the exact registered digest (owner-only; wrong bytes/wrong rights refused); access-controlled reads — consumers never read private artifact bytes (typed AccessDenied)

DETERMINISTIC PINNING: consumers pin an EXACT version (metadata selection); NO floating-latest resolve exists in the contract; pinned token deterministic (id+version+digest); resolve returns exactly that manifest

APPROVAL: deployable only with an explicit custodian approval bound to an accepted VMM-09 report (modelAccepted + zero model safety failures); wrong rights/failed reports rejected; deployment_status registered|approved
ROLLBACK: deterministic pointer change to an EARLIER APPROVED version only; forward rollback refused; user records untouched (userRecordsChanged: false)
INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION: verify_artifact recomputes digest + signature + lineage without operator trust; provenance walks dataset->model

verification.vmmTests: npm run ml:vmm:test -> 91/91 pass (81 previous + 10 registry)

status: Testing (submit candidate; D-095 separate reviewer + exact reviewed SHA required before Done)
gatesNotClosed: The registry is an in-memory contract plane; the storage/serving backend integration is future work. No model is deployed by this ticket. Testing status is not acceptance; the R0 research-gate prerequisite keeps its own signoff flow.
